title: Council: Wave 4 Priorities
summary: Priority stack after /book fix, /briefs ship, and offer ladder completion.
content:
Council Brief -- Wave 4 Priorities

Date: 2026-03-12 Agents present: Bobby, Alex, Mom Question: What's highest-impact now that /book is fixed, /briefs is shipped, and offer ladder is done?

Bobby

Ranked build queue: (1) /ideas rebuild (Elmo FAIL, no nav, broken UX, 2-3 hrs), (2) Home quick fixes (waitlist name attr, 30 min), (3) /case-study (Steffen 16-section spec ready), (4) /v2 redesign, (5) audit onboarding tool.

Alex

Revenue gaps: IH $9k (confirm today), KOHRS $2k, Ambition $2k/mo (3 weeks zero posts = retention risk). First AI advisory client: cold-call 3 CPAs this week. Phone > email. Offer free 30-min audit. One yes = $5-8k setup + recurring.

Mom

Tracking files stale. /book listed as broken (it's fixed). Bobby, Steffen, Jacob, Elon all have outdated statuses. Need full sync. Top priorities for Patrik: review 33 drafts, approve domain purchase, download AZ ROC CSV.

Synthesis

Where we agree: /ideas is the next build priority. Ambition retention is at risk. Tracking files need sync. Recommended Wave 4 missions:

  1. Bobby: Fix /ideas page (nav, brand, sub-16px)
  2. Colton: Fix /briefs sub-16px + home waitlist form
  3. Jacob: Scrub 33 drafts for zero-risk language
  4. Steffen: /ideas page quick design direction for Bobby
  5. Alex: AOM-as-case-study content for /case-study page
  6. Elon: Continue relay pipeline (always-on)
  7. Elmo: QA /briefs accordion (just shipped)
  8. Paige: Ambition retention risk assessment
  9. Steve: Multi-tenant architecture from dashboard spec
  10. Pixel: Continue game view (after Patrik Cmd+Q)
